summary_en: SBI Holdings completed the acquisition of Bitbank Inc., a cryptocurrency business operator, as a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction was finalized on October 1, 2026, following Bitbank's acquisition of its own shares from Mixi Inc. and Ceres Inc. The impact on SBI's consolidated results for fiscal year ended March 2027 is expected to be immaterial.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Full Subsidiary Status of Bitbank Inc.
translation_en_brief:
On October 1, 2026, SBI Holdings completed its acquisition of Bitbank Inc. as a wholly owned subsidiary, following the procedures announced on June 25, 2026. The transaction was finalized when Bitbank executed the acquisition of its own shares from two existing shareholders, Mixi Inc. and Ceres Inc., resulting in Bitbank becoming a fully consolidated subsidiary of SBI Holdings.

Bitbank Inc. is a cryptocurrency-related business operator established in May 2014, headquartered in Tokyo's Marunouchi area, with capital (including capital reserves) of 8.05 billion yen. The company is led by Representative Director and CEO Shigenobu Hirosue.

SBI Holdings expects the impact of this transaction on its consolidated results for the fiscal year ending March 2027 to be immaterial. The company will provide further updates if material information arises.
